name: Burial Ground
description: A historical or informal burial site.

name: Canton
description: A regional administrative unit, especially in Switzerland.

name: Cemetery
description: A designated burial ground.

name: Church
description: A religious building or congregation location.

name: Churchyard
description: A burial or gathering area adjacent to a church.

name: City
description: A large, incorporated urban settlement.

name: Commune
description: A local administrative unit common in parts of Europe and Africa.

name: Country
description: A national-level sovereign entity.

name: County
description: A common mid-level administrative division.

name: District
description: A mid-level administrative area within a region or state.

name: Estate
description: A large property, manor, or plantation.

name: Farm
description: An agricultural property or homestead.

name: Hamlet
description: A very small settlement, often without its own government.

name: Historic Site
description: A location of historical significance.

name: Hospital
description: A medical facility providing care.

name: Industrial Site
description: A factory, mill, foundry, or similar facility.

name: Military Base
description: A fort, camp, or military installation.

name: Monastery
description: A religious community or complex.

name: Municipality
description: A city, town, township, or local governing unit.

name: Neighborhood
description: A defined area within a city or town.

name: Parish
description: A religious or civil administrative area.

name: Port
description: A harbor or maritime facility.

name: Precinct
description: A voting, police, or administrative subdivision.

name: Prefecture
description: An administrative jurisdiction used in several countries.

name: Province
description: A major regional subdivision within a country.

name: Rail Station
description: A train station or railway stop.

name: Region
description: A broad geographical or administrative area.

name: Residence
description: A home, dwelling, or living place.

name: School
description: An educational institution.

name: School District
description: An administrative area for public schools.

name: State
description: A primary subdivision within a country.

name: Town
description: A mid-sized urban settlement.

name: Township
description: A local administrative or survey-based division.

name: Village
description: A small settlement, typically rural.

name: Ward
description: A subdivision of a city or municipality.

name: Workplace
description: A location where people are employed.
